title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Use and the Pocketwire Advance Room
content:
Customers who use a physical Pocketwire Visa Debit Card regularly have the room for a new Pocketwire Advance treated as follows. When the customer holds an active physical Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, Signature Debit, Infinite Debit or Infinite Metal Debit card and made at least 10 card purchases in the three months before the handling date, the room is multiplied by 1.10 before it is rounded down. When the customer holds an active physical Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit or Gold Debit card and made at least 10 card purchases in that window, 1.00 is added to the room for each card purchase in that window before it is rounded down. Otherwise the room is rounded down as it stands. In every case the rounding is down to a whole multiple of the tier's advance increment.

**Place of the treatment.** The card treatment acts on the room once the additions to the tier's advance limit and the deductions from it — the remaining principal of the line's advances among them — have all been made, and only the result of the card treatment is rounded down.

**The window.** A window of three months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month three months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date.

**What is read.** The tier, status and form of the customer's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card — active and physical — and the number of card purchase entries on the card ledger dated in the window.

## Treatment by card

| Active physical card | Card purchases in the window | Treatment of the room |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum, Signature, Infinite or Infinite Metal Debit | 10 or more | Multiplied by 1.10, then rounded down |
| Pocketwire Visa Classic or Gold Debit | 10 or more | 1.00 added per card purchase, then rounded down |
| Any tier | Fewer than 10 | Rounded down as it stands |
| No active physical card | Any number | Rounded down as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical room of 107.50 on a tier with an increment of 5.00)

| Card | Purchases | Room after the treatment | Rounded down |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active physical Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 12 | 118.25 | 115.00 |
| Active physical Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 14 | 121.50 | 120.00 |
| Active physical Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 8 | 107.50 | 105.00 |
| Locked physical Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 30 | 107.50 | 105.00 |
